primary_insight: Science treats the calibration sample as exchangeable with the unobserved remainder. When the remainder is generated by a different process, more n on the calibration generator cannot identify the target. The cleanest 2026 generator split no prior archive class owns is 3I/ATLAS: water D/H 15σ above the Solar System comet mean (Cordiner et al., Nature, 22 Jun 2026).
capability_gap_identified: No existing tool certifies, against the local archive of already-claimed structural classes, whether a scientific unknown is a missing place, missing converter, unjoined ledger, truncated coefficient, monopolized channel, coupling mismatch, or a calibration sample generated by the wrong process — i.e. whether more n from G_cal is in principle incapable of identifying G_target.
